title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・最後の大一番

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap manages to defeat Tamamo Cross in the illustrious autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next big race against Super Creek, the Arima Kinen, awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to keep winning, for the sake of everyone waiting for her to get stronger.
